notes: Oversized head and compact torso are present, but feet float, the body is too cylindrical, and the head-to-body transition lacks the soft cheek/chest overlap of the reference.
Neutral bilateral stance is recognizable, but limbs read as clipped cones and the ear-to-cheek negative spaces differ strongly from the locked silhouette.
The ears are long but point upward like rigid leaves. The reference ears attach high, bow outward, and hang down with their tips near the lower torso.
